name: Amalgam
author: E. T. Carter
description: Two quicksilver pools hang in open darkness, drift to apogee, swing back in a slow magnetic approach, snap together in a hot bloom at the neck, ring with a damped elliptical wobble, then reluctantly pinch apart — one phase-continuous round of fusion and loss.

params.label: Pool scale
params.effect: Radius scale of both pools in CSS pixels, changing how much of the frame the duet occupies.

params.label: Cycle speed
params.effect: How fast the approach, fusion, settle, and pinch-apart round runs.

params.label: Rim glow
params.effect: Brightness of the thin gradient-derived rim highlight on both bodies.

params.label: Flash strength
params.effect: Intensity of the bright snap at the neck at fusion and pinch-apart; at zero the topology still changes, just without the flash.
